t: What Does The Name Yeran Mean?
s: Outside Armenian, Yeran has several phonetic and orthographic variants shaped by local languages: in Russian and other Slavic records it may appear as Eran or Yeran (Еран); in Western European contexts it can be rendered as Yeran or Yéran, sometimes conflated with the Breton Yoran/Joran or the Occitan/Portuguese Eran; in Hebrew and modern Israeli contexts Eran (ערן, “cedar,” “vigilant”) is a distinct but near-homophonous name that often overlaps in diaspora usage; and in Persian and Kurdish registries one can find Eran/Iran as surnames or given names with different etymologies.
